**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject normalized path escapes when loading flow files**

`loadFlow` only blocks absolute paths and strings that literally start with `..`, so inputs like `flows/../../.env` pass validation and then `path.resolve(repoRoot, file)` reads outside the repository. This breaks the stated repo-relative contract and allows arbitrary local file reads through `run flow` in both CLI and MCP contexts.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Terminate detached dev servers by process group**

Spawned servers are started with `detached: true`, but `stopSession` sends SIGTERM only to `session.child` PID. With `shell: true`, that often kills only the shell wrapper and leaves the actual dev server running, so sessions can report completed while orphaned processes keep ports occupied and interfere with later runs.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Apply envAllowlist when spawning dev server process**

The config schema accepts `devServer.envAllowlist`, but spawned servers always receive `env: process.env`, so the allowlist is ignored entirely. This means users cannot constrain inherited environment variables, which can leak unrelated secrets into child processes and make runs less reproducible across environments.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

Prompt for AI agents ```text Check if this issue is valid — if so, understand the root cause and fix it. At probefn/docs/baselines.md, line 38: Don't tie mismatch errors to an unresolved key. Missing baselines and dimension mismatches are separate compare outcomes. @@ -0,0 +1,55 @@ +- pixel diff summary +- semantic/layout regressions +- diff image path +- missing-baseline or mismatch errors when the key does not resolve + +## Baseline Storage ```
diff_hunk:
@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+# Baselines
+
+Probefn stores visual baselines locally and compares new checkpoints against those local references.
+
+## Record A Baseline
+
+First create a checkpoint:
+
+```bash
+pnpm probefn checkpoint create --session sess_healthy --name landing --include-trace --include-styles --json
+```
+
+Then record a baseline:
+
+```bash
+pnpm probefn baseline record \
+  --session sess_healthy \
+  --checkpoint chk_landing \
+  --key home.desktop.chromium.light.1440x900.utc \
+  --json
+```
+
+## Compare Against A Baseline
+
+```bash
+pnpm probefn baseline compare \
+  --session sess_healthy \
+  --checkpoint chk_landing \
+  --key home.desktop.chromium.light.1440x900.utc \
+  --json
+```
+
+Comparison results include:
+
+- pixel diff summary
+- semantic/layout regressions
+- diff image path
+- missing-baseline or mismatch errors when the key does not resolve
